name: Gentlemen: Security software enumeration via SecurityCenter2 and EDR probing
description: wmic/PowerShell enumeration of root\SecurityCenter2 AntiVirusProduct, sc.exe query loops against EDR service names, or tasklist|findstr EDR process hunting (T1518.001) — The Gentlemen's pre-evasion reconnaissance.
query: process where (process.name : ("wmic.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and process.command_line : "*SecurityCenter2*" and process.command_line : "*AntiVirusProduct*") or (process.name : "sc.exe" and process.command_line : ("*query WinDefend*", "*query Sense*", "*query CSFalconService*", "*query Sophos*", "*query SepMasterService*", "*query WdNisSvc*")) or (process.name : "cmd.exe" and process.command_line : "*tasklist*" and process.command_line : "*findstr*" and (process.command_line : "*csagent*" or process.command_line : "*sophos*" or process.command_line : "*crowdstrike*" or process.command_line : "*sentinel*" or process.command_line : "*defender*"))

name: Gentlemen: Mass domain and local account enumeration via net.exe
description: Burst of net.exe user/group enumeration against /domain targets, local administrators, or __vmware__ virtualization groups (T1087) — The Gentlemen's 1.bat mass-enumeration shape.
query: process where process.name : ("net.exe", "net1.exe") and (process.command_line : "*user /domain*" or process.command_line : "*group*domain admins*" or process.command_line : "*group*Enterprise admins*" or process.command_line : "*localgroup administrators*" or process.command_line : "*__vmware__*")

name: Gentlemen: Encoded PowerShell recon probe with evasion flags
description: powershell launched with -enc/-EncodedCommand combined with -noni/-nop/-w 1 flags (T1082) — The Gentlemen's encoded probe decodes to (Get-ADDomain).PDCEmulator domain reconnaissance.
query: process where process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and (process.command_line : "*-enc *" or process.command_line : "*-EncodedCommand*") and (process.command_line : "*-noni*" or process.command_line : "*-nop*" or process.command_line : "*-w 1*")
false_positives: Legitimate automation using encoded commands — decode the payload before escalating

name: Gentlemen: Unsanctioned Velociraptor client deployment
description: Sequence of Velociraptor deployment artifact creation (client.config.yaml/client.writeback) followed by velociraptor process execution (T1219) — The Gentlemen repurposes the Velociraptor DFIR client as its remote-access C2 channel.
query: sequence by host.name with maxspan=15m [file where file.name : ("client.config.yaml", "client.writeback")] [process where process.name : "velociraptor*"]
false_positives: Sanctioned DFIR/IR Velociraptor deployments — allowlist approved hosts and operator accounts

name: Gentlemen: Velociraptor control-plane beacon pattern
description: HTTP requests to /control URLs carrying client_id=C.<hex> parameters or a Velociraptor User-Agent (T1219) — the client-to-frontend beacon of a Velociraptor deployment; flag any non-approved frontend destination.
query: network where (url.full : "*/control*" and url.full : "*client_id=C.*") or (user_agent.original : "Velociraptor*" and url.full : "*/control*")
false_positives: Sanctioned Velociraptor frontends — allowlist approved destinations and ports 8000/8800

name: Gentlemen: WMI remote process creation
description: wmic /node: process call create or PowerShell DCOM (New-CimSession -Protocol DCOM + Invoke-CimMethod Win32_Process.Create) remote execution (T1047) — The Gentlemen's living-off-the-land lateral execution primitive.
query: process where (process.name : "wmic.exe" and process.command_line : "*/node:*" and process.command_line : "*process call create*") or (process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and process.command_line : "*New-CimSession*" and process.command_line : "*Invoke-CimMethod*" and (process.command_line : "*DCOM*" or process.command_line : "*Win32_Process*"))
false_positives: Rare legitimate remote-admin scripts using WMI process creation

name: Gentlemen: NetExec credential dumping over SMB
description: nxc/netexec smb invocations with --sam/--lsa/--ntds dumping flags (T1021.002/T1003.002) — The Gentlemen's LOLBin credential harvesting for lateral spread.
query: process where (process.name : ("nxc.exe", "netexec.exe") or process.command_line : ("*nxc smb*", "*netexec smb*")) and (process.command_line : "*--sam*" or process.command_line : "*--lsa*" or process.command_line : "*--ntds*")

name: Gentlemen: SMB lateral movement via ADMIN$ share and tool transfer
description: Sequence of ADMIN$ session establishment (net use), executable write into ADMIN$, and remote execution via WMI or PsExec (T1021.002/T1570) — The Gentlemen's PsExec-style lateral spread.
query: sequence by host.name with maxspan=30m [process where process.name : ("net.exe", "net1.exe") and process.command_line : "*use*" and process.command_line : "*ADMIN$*"] [file where file.path : "*ADMIN$*" and file.extension : ("exe", "dll", "bat", "ps1", "sys")] [process where (process.name : "wmic.exe" and process.command_line : "*/node:*") or process.name : ("psexesvc.exe", "psexec.exe")]
false_positives: SCCM/PDQ/GPO software deployment pushes — allowlist deployment accounts

name: Gentlemen: RDP enablement via registry or firewall rule
description: reg add of fDenyTSConnections=0 or netsh advfirewall rule addition for RDP/3389 (T1021.001) — The Gentlemen enables RDP before pivoting between internal systems.
query: process where (process.name : "reg.exe" and process.command_line : "*fDenyTSConnections*" and process.command_line : "*add*") or (process.name : "netsh.exe" and process.command_line : "*advfirewall*" and process.command_line : "*add rule*" and (process.command_line : "*3389*" or process.command_line : "*rdp*"))
false_positives: Server builds enabling RDP by design — baseline and allowlist server images

name: Gentlemen: Group Policy modification via GPME or GroupPolicy cmdlets
description: GPME launched against an LDAP-addressed GPO (gpobject:LDAP://) or GPO manipulation via New-GPO/Set-GPRegistryValue/New-GPLink (T1484.001) — The Gentlemen's domain-wide deployment mechanism.
query: process where (process.command_line : "*gpobject:*" and process.command_line : "*LDAP://*") or (process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and (process.command_line : "*New-GPO*" or process.command_line : "*Set-GPRegistryValue*" or process.command_line : "*New-GPLink*" or process.command_line : "*Set-GPPermissions*"))
false_positives: Group Policy administrators working from DCs or tier-0 management stations

name: Gentlemen: Registry.pol or gpt.ini written in SYSVOL policy path
description: Registry.pol or gpt.ini file creation/modification inside SYSVOL policy folders (T1484.001) — the file surface of malicious GPO payload deployment; flag writes not originating from approved GPO management tooling.
query: file where file.name : ("Registry.pol", "gpt.ini") and file.path : "*SYSVOL*" and file.path : "*Policies*"
false_positives: Legitimate GPMC/AGPM policy edits — restrict alerts to non-DC hosts or unusual initiating processes

name: Gentlemen: Payload execution from NETLOGON share
description: Process launch of an executable/batch from the NETLOGON share, especially with an embedded --password key (T1484.001) — The Gentlemen's domain-wide deployment launcher shape.
query: process where process.command_line : "*NETLOGON*" and (process.command_line : "*--password*" or process.command_line : "*.exe" or process.command_line : "*.bat" or process.command_line : "*.cmd")
false_positives: Legacy logon scripts — allowlist approved script names in NETLOGON

name: Gentlemen: Redundant persistence sequence — SYSTEM task, masqueraded service, privileged account
description: Sequence of masqueraded SYSTEM scheduled task creation, service creation with staging-path binary, local account creation, and Administrators group elevation (T1053.005/T1543.003/T1136.001) — The Gentlemen's redundant persistence stack.
query: sequence by host.name with maxspan=45m [process where process.name : "schtasks.exe" and process.command_line : "*/create*" and process.command_line : "*/ru*SYSTEM*"] [process where process.name : "sc.exe" and process.command_line : "*create*" and process.command_line : "*binPath=*" and (process.command_line : "*Temp*" or process.command_line : "*PerfLogs*" or process.command_line : "*Public*")] [process where process.name : ("net.exe", "net1.exe") and process.command_line : "*user*" and process.command_line : "*/add*"] [process where process.name : ("net.exe", "net1.exe") and process.command_line : "*localgroup administrators*" and process.command_line : "*/add*"]
false_positives: Software installers creating a task, service and service account — rare; verify against change management
